body.name: Bit-certified orbit-compiler handle
body.construction: Construct \(\mathfrak C\) by canonical size-tagged response, assignment, and observation histograms; compute every stabilizer-weighted coefficient by bounded-alphabet dynamic programming; perform rational facial reduction for zero-mass cells; invoke weak second-order-cone optimization; outward-round and directly verify the resulting primal and dual risks; decode the continuous estimator through the Bernoulli histogram recursion from \(\texttt{def:endpoint-extension}\).
